test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following Schedules of the Constitution of India contains a list of central and state laws which CANNOT be challenged in courts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ninth Schedule.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Ninth Schedule **contains a list of **central and state legislation** that is not subject to legal challenge.
 
• There are now **284 **such laws that are **immune** from judicial review.
 
• The blanket immunity given to laws listed in Schedule 9 was affected by a landmark decision made by the Supreme Court of India in the case of IR Coelho vs. State of Tamil Nadu (2007).
